text: Marquez Brothers International, Inc., owner of the El Mexicano Brand (per its CEO's statement in LAFC's announcement), is a family-owned company founded in 1981; Gustavo Marquez Jr. is its CEO and President.
short: Marquez Brothers International, Inc., owner of the El Mexicano Brand, is a family-owned company founded in 1981.

source.name: Perishable News: Marquez Brothers International, Inc's. Brands Win Best of Class for Cheese and Yogurt at 2026 World Championship Cheese Contest
source.quote: Marquez Brothers International, Inc. (MBI) is a family-owned company and a leading producer of authentic Hispanic dairy products in the United States.
source.note: Company-issued press release carried by the trade outlet Perishable News; the page also quotes 'Gustavo Marquez JR CEO / President of Marquez Brothers'.
